name: Unpaywall_check_oa_status
description: Query a DOI in Unpaywall with DOI normalization and returned-identity verification. Returns the complete source record plus convenience OA status fields, all current and embargoed OA locations, evidence, licenses, repository institutions, authors, journal flags, and explicit location counts. Requires a valid contact email.

doi.description: DOI (Digital Object Identifier) of the article to check for open access status.

email.description: Contact email address required by Unpaywall API for polite usage tracking.

authors.description: The author list, each with author_position ('first', 'middle', 'last'), is_corresponding, raw_affiliation_strings and name parts. 8 on the measured record, and the only place authorship and affiliation appear.

data_standard.description: Which Unpaywall data generation the record was built with, e.g. 2. Records built under an older standard are not directly comparable.

first_oa_location.description: The copy Unpaywall would send a reader to, with the same fields as an entry in oa_locations. Which of several copies is the preferred one; the list order does not say.

genre.description: What kind of work it is, e.g. 'journal-article', 'book-chapter', 'posted-content'. A preprint and an article carry different weight and this is the only field that separates them.

has_repository_copy.description: True when a copy sits in a repository. Green open access survives a publisher paywalling the article again, so this is the durable route.

is_paratext.description: True when the record is front matter, an index or an editorial listing rather than a work. Counting paratext as articles inflates any count built from a search.

journal_is_in_doaj.description: True when the journal is indexed in DOAJ. The usual proxy for a vetted open-access journal rather than a predatory one.

journal_is_oa.description: True when the journal itself is fully open access, as distinct from this one article being free.

journal_issn_l.description: The linking ISSN, e.g. '0028-0836' - the one id that is stable across a journal's print and electronic forms.

journal_issns.description: Every ISSN for the journal as a comma-delimited STRING, e.g. '0028-0836,1476-4687'. Not a list.

oa_locations.description: Every open copy Unpaywall knows, each with host_type ('publisher' or 'repository'), url_for_pdf, license, version ('publishedVersion', 'acceptedVersion', 'submittedVersion'), oa_date and evidence. 5 on the measured record. The version matters: an accepted manuscript is not the published paper.

publisher.description: Publisher name, e.g. 'Springer Science and Business Media LLC'.

updated.description: When Unpaywall last refreshed the record, e.g. '2026-11-10T14:03:09Z'. OA status changes, so this says how stale the answer may be.

name: Unpaywall_get_full_text_url
description: Retrieve full-text and landing-page URLs from Unpaywall after normalizing and verifying the DOI. Returns the best location plus every full 13-field OA location record (including evidence, OA date, endpoint/PMH IDs, repository institution, update date, license and version), embargoed locations, and the complete source record. No location qualifiers are silently projected away.

doi.description: DOI (Digital Object Identifier) of the article, e.g. '10.1038/nature12373'.

email.description: Contact email for Unpaywall API polite pool. Defaults to 'tools@tooluniverse.org' if not provided.
